title: Add automatic retry for card-production database deadlocks
description: Modify card-production database retry logic. When a database deadlock occurs during batch processing, automatically retry the failed database operation up to three times.
implementation_plan: Deploy updated retry logic to the card-production batch processor. Database operations that fail with a deadlock will be retried up to three times before the batch is marked as failed.
rollback_plan: Deploy the previous application version if issues are observed after implementation.
testing_summary: Test successful card production and verify that processing completes after a simulated database deadlock.
